mandates.name: anvil:nadia

mandate.title: Nadia: daily life in Hong Kong
sentences: Pay my rent, 9,500, to Harbour Homes on the 1st.
Keep food under 3,000 a month.
Never let my balance drop below 1,500.
Pay the tuition deposit to HBU before 1 November.
Ask me above 2,000 or for anyone new.
Only put idle cash into low-risk products.
The agent can only touch these assets: tHKD and tUSD.
It can only call: transfer and transferAndCall. Approvals and any other function are refused.
It can never send the native coin.

It can never call your own account or 8 protocol contracts (DelegationManager, EntryPoint, PayeeBook, MandateRegistry, KillSwitchRegistry, YinglongPassportRegistry, AccountabilityLedger and ProductRegistry).
Everything stops the moment you press Pause, your guardian pauses, or the supervisor halts this agent.
Only agents whose passport is bound to your identity can use this mandate.
It works only while mandate 0x4c39b2e4... is live in the public mandate registry.
Jurisdiction: Hong Kong. Rails allowed: tHKD and tUSD.
Money goes only to payees in your payee book or to agents attested by Harbour Bay University and Harbour Digital Bank, through escrow (ProtectedPayment) and quote settlement only.
Payments above 2,000 tHKD need your approval on your phone (except rent up to 9,500 tHKD); anyone new above 50 tHKD also needs you; nothing above 12,000 tHKD is possible at all.
Payments above 300 tUSD need your approval on your phone; anyone new above 1,500 tUSD also needs you; nothing above 2,500 tUSD is possible at all.
Every 30 days: rent at most 9,500 tHKD, food at most 3,000 tHKD, tuition at most 12,000 tHKD, treasury at most 5,000 tHKD and services at most 200 tHKD.
Every 30 days: services at most 2,500 tUSD.
Your tHKD balance never goes below 1,500 tHKD.
At most 8 payments and 15,000 tHKD per day.
Idle cash goes only into products of risk class 2 or lower.
